title: Music City Memories Condo - 8 min to Broadway/BNA
description:
Welcome to Music City where the history of music and live performance are deeply written. Nashville is THE place to explore legendary music venues, historic sites, and nightly shows. Let our condo be your nostalgic break from the excitement and fun of making your own Music City Memories!

**All Airbnb service fees now included in nightly rate. Only cleaning and taxes added for total.

The space
-Easy free parking and stair/ramp access.
-Queen size bed
-Washer/dryer in unit
-Wi-Fi and Smart TV for streaming your subscription accounts
-Record Player
-Kitchen fully stocked with cookware, Keurig, toaster, and microwave
-Starter toilet paper, paper towels, and coffee are provided
-NO SMOKING
-NO PARTIES
-NO PETS ($100/day fee)

Other things to note
Everything Nashville has to offer is a close ride from the condo.
